hints.title: Binary Run Compression
hints.text: Inspect contiguous runs of 1s in the binary representation of n.

hints.title: Carry Generation
hints.text: Adding 1 to a run of two or more 1s produces a carry that collapses the whole group into a single high bit with one addition and one subtraction.

hints.title: Booth Multiplier Analogy
hints.text: The minimum number of operations equals the Hamming weight of the canonical signed-digit form, which simplifies to the set bits of n xor (3 * n).

hints.title: Bitwise Canonical Decomposition Implementation

complexity.notes: Bitwise xor and popcount execute in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive exploration of all add/subtract paths has branching factor 2.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses bit manipulation or greedy bit shifts to clear contiguous ones.
